title: Ghost Rider: Nicolas Cage Movie Writer Offers Advice for Ryan Gosling MCU Reboot
content:
Scott M. Gimple, co-writer of 2012’s Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance, has offered some advice for Ryan Gosling’s upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe reboot. The 55-year-old screenwriter recently reflected on his experience scripting Nicolas Cage’s final outing as Johnny Blaze during a recent interview.
